n01.query: During training of the original RAG model, which retriever components are kept fixed and which components are fine-tuned?
n01.rewritten_query: RA⁠G training retriever components fixed frozen parameters fine-tuned components
n01.hypothetical_document: During training of the original RAG model, the document retriever and query encoder components are typically kept fixed, while the generator is fine-tuned. This selective fine-tuning allows the retriever to remain frozen while the model learns to leverage retrieved passages for generation.
